g.text: Nominal flow — order placed to delivery completed
(all client calls pass through gateway; omitted for clarity)
Simulated merchant (internal component of order service):
auto-confirms and declares ready after a configurable delay
(MER-01 + MER-02). No external interface in V1.
Courier posts position every ~5 s (COU-05 / SIM).
tracking stores the raw position, pushes an SSE update to the
customer app, and publishes CourierPositionSampled every 15 s
when the simulated provider callback fires.
May arrive before or after delivery.
